intended_object: A hard-coded piece of certificate data: the flat postorder list of claims for search branch (2, 10) in a computer-checked coverage certificate. It belongs to the Erdős #97 convex-octagon formalization. This is inferred from the docstring, the name and the module name (CoverageCertificateData02).
explanation: The definition is a literal `BranchClaims` value. It is made of an array holding one claim group (`branchClaims2And10Group00`) and the two numbers 15 and 14. It is generated data that a proof-by-computation certificate checker reads for one branch of a case analysis. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so there is no standard object to compare it against.
